# Feature: Warp and level progression

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Complete the level loop: the warp tile behind the gate takes the player to the next level, and progression state tracks the current level.

## User Story

**As a** player
**I want** finishing a level to load the next one
**So that** I can progress through the level set.

## High-Level Use Case

Player collects all orbs, the gate opens, the player steps on the warp, and the next level loads with the level counter advanced.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given an open gate, when the player steps on the warp, then the next level loads.
- Given progression, then the current-level counter advances.

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Warp is only reachable behind the gate (gate rules from orbs-and-gate).
- Last-level behaviour follows the open question below until resolved.

## UI / Feedback

- Current-level display advances; next level renders.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: an ordered level list.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Warp behind the gate loads the next level.
- [ ] Level counter advances.

## Out of Scope

- Level select beyond the game menu basics.

## Open Questions

- What happens after the last level: loop, win screen, or back to menu? Resolve during implementation and record the choice here.

## Testing

Needs a mechanics playground: reuse — the orbs-room Test Level plus a second level to warp into. Verification should record play sessions for replay.
